caption: The drawing depicts a single, prominently centered helmet rendered in shades of brown and gray. The helmet has a wide, flared brim with decorative patterns etched on it and a high, pointed crown that extends upwards with a slight curve at the tip. The helmet is shown tilted to the right, with its right brim raised and the left brim laying flatter. Textured shading highlights the three-dimensional form and surface details of the helmet. The background is a plain, light beige with no additional objects, and the artist’s signature “Tarsila 1929” is located in the lower right corner.
title: Fireman's Hat
